notes: מֵעָלַי is split: מִן takes *from* and עַל is unrepresented, since the single English word drops the עַל's own sense — the גָּדַל … מִן case of rules 30 and 35 rather than a fusion.
כֻּלָּם: the ASV writes only *all*, so the construct noun takes it and the suffix is unrepresented under rule 22; rule 19's *all of them* treatment does not arise.
